prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name a single “best” interior painting company for all situations — the best one depends on what you need (whole house vs. one room, level of prep/repairs, budget, timeline, eco-friendly paint, warranty, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me narrow recommendations:

- Is this residential or commercial?
- Zip code or neighborhood in St. Louis?
- Scope: one room, several rooms, whole interior, or new construction?
- Approximate budget and timeline?
- Any special requirements (lead paint concerns, high ceilings, trim/cabinet painting, low-VOC paints, color consulting)?

Meanwhile, here are immediate, practical tips and a checklist to find a top interior painter in St. Louis:

How to pick the best company
- Check current reviews on Google, Yelp, Angi, and the Better Business Bureau. Look for consistently good ratings and responses to complaints.
- Verify license and insurance (general liability and workers’ comp).
- Ask for three written, itemized estimates (labor, materials, number of coats, prep work).
- Get references and photos of recent similar jobs. Call one or two past clients.
- Confirm cleanup, protection of floors/furniture, and how they handle repairs (drywall, caulking).
- Ask about paint brands and warranty (some contractors offer written workmanship warranties).
- Confirm timeline, start/end dates, and payment schedule (avoid large up-front payments).

Sample questions to ask a painter
- Are you licensed/insured? Can you provide proof?
- Do you have references for similar interior jobs in St. Louis?
- How many coats of paint do you recommend, and which brands/finishes do you use?
- How will you prepare surfaces and protect floors/furniture?
- What is included in this estimate? Are there potential extra costs?
- What is your warranty on workmanship?

Ballpark costs (very approximate)
- Single bedroom: $300–$1,000 depending on prep and detail.
- Whole interior of a typical 2,000 sq ft house: $3,000–$10,000 depending on scope, trim, ceilings, and paint quality.
These vary a lot; get local estimates.

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a short list of highly rated St. Louis painters (if you give a zip code), or
- Draft an email/template message you can send to painters requesting estimates, or
- Provide a comparison checklist you can print and use when you meet contractors.

Which would you like to do next?
